import collections, hashlib, json, pathlib, re, sys, tempfile, zipfile
from unittest.mock import patch
root=pathlib.Path(r'D:\Desktop\fin-ai-agent')
scratch=pathlib.Path(r'C:\Users\admin\AppData\Local\Temp\fin_acceptance_20261012_epp555rm')
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'agent'))
from audit.claim_check import check_one_claim
from audit.tools.compare import compare_companies
from audit.tools.compute import compute_trend
from audit.tools.search import search_text,document_key
from eval_harness import ReplayClient,run_full_flow,score_atomic
from materials import Run
def fact(code='600519',name='贵州茅台',year=2024,value='100',eid='mt',doc=None,**extra):
    f={'evidence_id':eid,'company_code':code,'company_name':name,
       'metric':'revenue','metric_name':'营业收入','period_year':year,'report_year':year,
       'period_kind':'annual','period_start':f'{year}-01-01','period_end':f'{year}-12-31',
       'duration_months':12,'comparison_group':f'{code}|{year}|table','document_id':doc or f'doc-{code}-{year}',
       'source_file':f'data/{code}-{year}.pdf','source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(f'{code}|{year}|{doc or eid}'.encode()).hexdigest(),
       'value':value,'unit':'元','normalized_value':value,'normalized_unit':'元',
       'currency':'CNY','scope':'consolidated','adjustment':'as_reported','issues':[],
       'page':5,'value_bbox':[0,0,1,1]}
    f.update(extra);return f
def item(quote,**extra):
    d={'claim_id':'C1','sentence_id':1,'quote':quote,'context_quote':None,
       'claim_type':'amount','company_name':'贵州茅台','company_b':None,'comparison_operator':None,
       'period_year':2024,'period_kind':'annual','metric_text':'营业收入','metric':'revenue',
       'scope':'consolidated','kind':'amount','value':'100','unit':'元','operator':'eq',
       'tolerance_pct':None,'direction':'unknown','currency':'CNY','qualifier':'exact',
       'plain_claim':'示例','is_forecast':False,'ambiguity':'none','verification_action':'compare_amount'}
    d.update(extra);return d
def compact(row):
    return {k:row.get(k) for k in ('status','track','reason_code','reason','evidence_ids','grounding','expected','calculation')}
probes={}
mt=fact();wly=fact(code='000858',name='五粮液',value='80',eid='wly')
sentence='2024年贵州茅台营业收入为80元，五粮液营业收入为80元。'
probes['company_quote_overridden_within_same_sentence']={
 'sentence':sentence,'quote':'贵州茅台营业收入为80元','model_company':'五粮液',
 'expected':'茅台为100：该金额应确认错误或拒绝错配',
 'actual':compact(check_one_claim(item('贵州茅台营业收入为80元',company_name='五粮液',value='80'),[mt,wly],sentence,sentence,'P1'))}
old=fact(year=2023,value='80',eid='mt2023')
sentence='2024年贵州茅台营业收入为80元。';context='2023年贵州茅台营业收入为80元。'
probes['period_model_context_overrides_explicit_year']={
 'sentence':sentence,'model_year':2023,'context':context,
 'expected':'2024年为100：拒绝用2023年80作支持',
 'actual':compact(check_one_claim(item(sentence,period_year=2023,value='80',context_quote=context),[mt,old],sentence,context+'\n'+sentence,'P2'))}
sentence='2024年上半年贵州茅台营业收入高于五粮液。'
half_mt=fact(value='50',eid='mt-h1',doc='mt-h1',period_kind='half',period_end='2024-06-30',duration_months=6)
half_wly=fact(code='000858',name='五粮液',value='100',eid='wly-h1',doc='wly-h1',period_kind='half',period_end='2024-06-30',duration_months=6)
comparison=item(sentence,claim_type='comparison',company_b='五粮液',comparison_operator='exceed')
probes['comparison_discards_explicit_half_year_conflict']={
 'sentence':sentence,'model_period_kind':'annual','expected':'半年50<100，拒绝年度100>80替代',
 'actual':compact(check_one_claim(comparison,[mt,wly,half_mt,half_wly],sentence,sentence,'P3'))}
single=fact(value='120',eid='mt-q3',period_kind='quarter',period_start='2024-07-01',period_end='2024-09-30',duration_months=3)
cumulative=fact(code='000858',name='五粮液',value='100',eid='wly-ytd',period_kind='quarter',period_start='2024-01-01',period_end='2024-09-30',duration_months=9)
probes['comparison_single_quarter_vs_cumulative']={
 'expected':'needs_review/period_mismatch：三个月不能和九个月累计直接比',
 'actual':compare_companies([single,cumulative],company_a='600519',company_b='000858',metric='revenue',period_year=2024,operator='exceed')}
series=[fact(year=y,value=v,eid=f'mt-{y}') for y,v in ((2022,'100'),(2023,'120'),(2024,'150'))]
for name,kw in (('trend_wrong_report_kind',{'report_kind':'half'}),('trend_nonexistent_document',{'document_id':'missing'}),('trend_unknown_cross_report_basis',{})):
 probes[name]={'expected':'拒绝未匹配条件或未知跨报告可比性','actual':compute_trend(series,company_name_or_code='600519',metric='revenue',start_year=2022,end_year=2024,**kw)}
unsafe=[*series[:-1],{**series[-1],'auto_usable':False,'review_reasons':['second_path_unresolved']}]
probes['trend_ignores_review_restriction']={'expected':'禁止使用明确待复核事实计算确定性趋势',
 'actual':compute_trend(unsafe,company_name_or_code='600519',metric='revenue',start_year=2022,end_year=2024)}
full='营收为100元，归母净利润为50元。'
checks=[{'claim_id':'a','sentence_id':1,'original_sentence':full,'quote':'营收为100元','status':'证据支持','track':'deterministic','evidence_ids':['e1']},
        {'claim_id':'b','sentence_id':1,'original_sentence':full,'quote':'归母净利润为50元','status':'确认错误','track':'deterministic','evidence_ids':['e2']}]
statements=[{'id':'a','sentence_id':1,'quote':'营收为100元','expect':{'kind':'judge','error':False}},
            {'id':'b','sentence_id':1,'quote':'归母净利润为50元','expect':{'kind':'judge','error':True}}]
probes['atomic_score_reuses_first_row']={'expected':'两个判定均与金标一致，correct=2/wrong=0',
 'actual':score_atomic({'status':'completed','checks':checks},statements)}
missing_statements=[{**s,'expect':{'kind':'judge','error':False}} for s in statements]
probes['atomic_score_hides_omitted_second_claim']={'expected':'只有一个原子结果，correct=1/omitted=1',
 'actual':score_atomic({'status':'completed','checks':checks[:1]},missing_statements)}
current=fact(value='120',eid='mt-current')
previous=fact(year=2023,value='100',eid='mt-previous',report_year=2024,document_id=current['document_id'],comparison_group=current['comparison_group'])
sentence='2024年贵州茅台营业收入下降。'
probes['direction_model_overrides_explicit_word']={'sentence':sentence,'model_direction':'up',
 'expected':'100→120，与原文下降冲突，不能给证据支持',
 'actual':compact(check_one_claim(item(sentence,claim_type='direction',direction='up',value=None,unit=None,operator='none'),[current,previous],sentence,sentence,'P4'))}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='acceptance_tool_failure_') as temp:
 run=Run(pathlib.Path(temp),'acceptance-probe',{})
 sentence='2024年贵州茅台营业收入高于五粮液。'
 with patch('audit.tools.compare.compare_companies',side_effect=TypeError('acceptance injected tool failure')):
  bundle=run_full_flow(sentence,[mt,wly],run,ReplayClient(items=[item(sentence,claim_type='comparison',company_b='五粮液',comparison_operator='exceed')]),use_loop=False)
 probes['tool_exception_is_completed']={'expected':'程序异常记为失败或partial，可恢复，不得复用为completed',
  'actual':{'status':bundle['status'],'chunks':bundle['chunks'],'failed_chunks':bundle['failed_chunks'],
            'unfinished_sentence_ids':bundle['unfinished_sentence_ids'],'checks':[compact(r) for r in bundle['checks']]}}
# No real model or remote data requests.
record={'project_root':str(root),'live_model_requests':0,'probes':probes}
(scratch/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
for name,p in probes.items():
 actual=p['actual']
 if isinstance(actual,dict) and 'summary' in actual:
  actual={'summary':actual['summary'],'rows':[{k:r.get(k) for k in ('id','status','outcome','ok')} for r in actual['rows']]}
 elif name.startswith('trend_'):
  actual={k:actual.get(k) for k in ('status','report_kind','series','cagr_pct','monotonic_up','error')}
 print(json.dumps({'probe':name,'expected':p['expected'],'actual':actual},ensure_ascii=False))

# Cross-company model direction must also agree with the quoted wording.
sentence='2024年贵州茅台营业收入低于五粮液。'
probes['comparison_operator_overrides_explicit_word']={
 'sentence':sentence,'model_operator':'exceed','expected':'100>80 与原文低于相反，不得返回证据支持',
 'actual':compact(check_one_claim(item(sentence,claim_type='comparison',company_b='五粮液',comparison_operator='exceed'),[mt,wly],sentence,sentence,'P5'))}
(scratch/'probes.json').write_text(json.dumps({'project_root':str(root),'live_model_requests':0,'probes':probes},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'probe':'comparison_operator_overrides_explicit_word','actual':probes['comparison_operator_overrides_explicit_word']['actual']},ensure_ascii=False))
